It is not propagated into frank_erinnerung_schreiben, frank_auftrag_stellen, frank_forschung or their durable/downstream action records.
semantic_atoms.triggerword4_contract: Carry immutable invocation_id/tool_use_id plus session/generation/causal identity through admission, downstream execution, outcome verification, result re-entry and completion evidence; protocol response correlation alone is insufficient effect identity.

semantic_atoms.claim: frank_erinnerung_schreiben directly enters stern.gespraech_erinnerung_schreiben through the in-process _stern dispatcher. That function inserts subject/value/source into the dedicated gespraech_erinnerung table and commits. The donor intentionally isolates this from durable_memory, but the Realtime model function-call path itself provides no independent user-confirmation or call-scoped effect/admission receipt before this persistent state mutation.

The dedicated table is a useful donor boundary; Frankenstein-2.0 must still classify model-proposed memory as provenance-bearing candidate/user-communication state rather than letting model output silently mint canonical fact authority.
triggerword4_contract: Persist model-proposed memory only through a typed memory-entry/admission record carrying user/source provenance and immutable invocation identity.
Keep model interpretation distinct from observed user utterance and canonical fact status.
Preserve the donor's separation from generic durable_memory unless an explicit migration contract proves equivalent invariants.

semantic_atoms.claim: frank_auftrag_stellen has a real voice-local two-stage gate: exact normalized task match, at least one new server-transcribed user utterance, 300-second expiry and explicit contradiction-keyword veto are required before dispatch. After that gate, the task is sent asynchronously to claude_frage(), which launches headless Claude Code. Current source hard-blocks the entire Bash tool, including under bypassPermissions, but explicitly retains file Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob capability; historical Git reports real verification that ordinary file writes still succeed.
semantic_atoms.authority_boundary: The confirmation state machine is real enforcement before this specific voice-to-Claude dispatch, but it is not by itself the canonical EntityOS EffectGate. Any later host hook/wache-koenig blocker remains unresolved and may add stricter authority downstream.
triggerword4_contract: Retain the two-stage user-confirmation concept as an upstream human-intent admission signal.
Bind the confirmed utterance and exact normalized request digest to the immutable invocation/effect identity.

Route every state-changing downstream Write/Edit or other effect through one deterministic EffectGate/EffectJournal boundary; tool allow/deny lists are capability constraints, not completion/effect authority.
Prove actual DENY non-execution and wrong-call identity rejection under parallel and reverse-completion tests.

semantic_atoms.claim: Barge-in/non-completed response cancellation is strong only before local dispatch: queued calls are discarded before _tool_ausfuehren. Once _tool_ausfuehren begins, current source has no call-scoped pending-effect lease propagated into the memory/Claude/research downstream paths. Therefore CANCELLED-before-dispatch and SUBMITTED/EXECUTING must remain distinct typed states.

architecture_changes: Introduce a VoiceToolInvocation envelope carrying call/tool identity, request digest, session/generation/causal identity, transcript evidence and confirmation evidence into every state-changing downstream path.
Treat voice-local confirmation as an admission signal, not as canonical execution/completion authority.
Move persistent memory writes behind typed memory admission with explicit epistemic class; do not silently upgrade model-selected summary text into canonical facts.
Unify pre-dispatch cancellation with PENDING_EFFECT while preserving SUBMITTED -> OUTCOME_UNKNOWN/VERIFIED semantics after an irreversible boundary.
